description: Test prompts that verify rdk-command-manual triggers and produces correct, board-aware command-manual answers. Prompts are phrased the way a real RDK developer would ask (Chinese). Run with-skill vs baseline and grade the assertions.

evals.name: boardid-x5-no-getset
evals.prompt: hrut_boardid 在 RDK X5 上为什么没有 g、s 这些选项？该怎么用？
evals.expected_output: Explains the g/s/G/S/c/C set is X3-only; on X5 hrut_boardid is print-only with -h.

assertions.text: States the g/s/G/S/c/C sub-options are X3-only.
States that on X5 hrut_boardid only prints the current boardid (its only flag is -h).
Does NOT claim a write/set option exists on X5.

evals.name: rdkos_info-d-vs-default
evals.prompt: rdkos_info -d 和默认输出有什么区别？我想收集信息发 issue。
evals.expected_output: Detailed mode appends 300 log lines vs default simple mode 30 lines; recommends it as a bug-report snapshot.

assertions.text: Says -d is detailed mode with the latest 300 log lines.
Says the default (-s simple) shows 30 log lines (or that default differs by log-line count).
Recommends rdkos_info as the snapshot to collect for a bug report.

evals.name: s100-miniboot-not-x-path
evals.prompt: S100 上怎么更新 miniboot？用 rdk-miniboot-update 吗？
evals.expected_output: rdk-miniboot-update is X-series; not in the S appendix; route S100 to the OTA miniboot flow (and xburn for full flashing).

assertions.text: Notes rdk-miniboot-update is documented for X-series and is not in the S-series command appendix.
Routes S100 miniboot update to the OTA flow (or recommends verifying on-board with which / -h first).

evals.name: srpi-config-not-ultra
evals.prompt: RDK Ultra 上 srpi-config 怎么开 SSH？菜单在哪？
evals.expected_output: srpi-config is NOT available on Ultra (documented for X3/X5/X3 Module only); SSH is under Interface Options on the supported boards.

assertions.text: States srpi-config is not supported on RDK Ultra (X3/X5/X3 Module only).
On supported boards, places SSH under Interface Options.

evals.name: devmem-syntax
evals.prompt: devmem 怎么读写寄存器？位宽参数怎么填？
evals.expected_output: devmem ADDRESS [WIDTH [VALUE]]; WIDTH 8/16/32 default 32; VALUE present=write, absent=read.

assertions.text: States WIDTH is 8/16/32 and defaults to 32 when omitted.
States that providing VALUE writes, omitting it reads.
